title: Heather Wishart-Smith (public board director) writes up the keynote — 'The question every board should ask: “Who would we rather die than betray?”'
summary: A public company board director turns the keynote into a governance brief for other directors: the Sol Price lineage from FedMart to Costco's $1.50 hot dog, Eric's definition of corruption as making money without creating value, his research that foundation-governed companies like Novo Nordisk and Zeiss far more often reach fifty, and the four elements he puts under new governance. She closes by asking directors whether their own board would pass the hot dog test.
blockquote: - The question every board should ask: “Who would we rather die than betray?”
